Before Honourable Mr. Justice Suman Shyam Order Date : 19-10-2020
texts.arguments: Petitioners are aggrieved by the notification dated 23-09-2020, whereby prohibition on blending of edible vegetable oil with the mustered oil has been imposed w.e.f. 01-10- 2020. Mr. Misra, learned Sr. counsel submits that such order of prohibition could not have been issued by the authorities in violation of Section 92 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 more so, when the draft amendment to the regulation has yet to received the approval of the parliament. The learned Sr. counsel has also invited the attention of this Court to the interim order dated 29-09-2020 passed by the Delhi High Court in ( B.R. Oil Industries Pvt. Ltd Vs. Union of India & Anr. ) staying operation of the notification dated 23-09-2020 so as to contend that keeping in mind uniformity in the matter of Page No.# 3/4 judicial orders, a similar interim order is required to be passed in this case as well. Mr. Pracha, on the other hand, has refuted the submission made by the learned counsel for the petitioners to contend that the Central Government is not only authorized to issue appropriate instruction to the Food Authority but in the present case, such instructions have been issued keeping in mind the public interest at large insofar as the food safety measures are concerned. It is also the submission of Mr. Pracha that the interim order dated 29-09-2020 passed by the Delhi High Court was an ex-parte order and the matter is fixed for reconsideration on 22-10-2020. Mr. Misra has, however, submitted that there are number of writ petitions pending on the issue before the Delhi High Court and the interim order passed on 29-09-2020 has already been extended.
